samples.question: Start at the green circle. At each purple junction, ignore the link just used and take the one of the two forward links crossed by fewer yellow tick marks. Repeat until a colored terminal is reached. A tick is one short yellow bar crossing one black link; links meet only at circles and never cross, and tied choices do not occur. Which terminal color is reached? Answer red, blue, orange, or cyan.
